title: Miss Minutes — Android runtime character asset

currentAssetAudit.note: These are the measured values from the CI validator for the exact runtime asset currently staged into the Android app.

rig.skinning: No glTF skin objects, no JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 and no skinned primitives in this Android runtime asset.
rig.handStructure: Four static finger segment meshes plus one thumb per hand; no independent finger-joint chains or ring-finger articulation.
rig.facialDeformation: Separate transform-controlled facial parts and expression nodes exist; no morph targets or vertex-level facial deformation.
rig.clock: Clock dial and tick marks exist; separate hour-hand and minute-hand geometry/control nodes are not present.

runtime.behavior: AI returns semantic mood/gaze/head tilt/body lean/gesture/energy/emphasis; Android resolves intent to a validated named clip, plays one-shot gestures once, returns to idle, and adjusts playback speed.
runtime.overlay: Floating overlay observes the same SharedPreferences motion state as the main activity, including Talk_Loop while ElevenLabs audio is playing.
runtime.limitations: This is AI-directed clip scheduling over node-transform animation. It is not yet a live bone-pose solver, layered skeletal animation system, morph-weight driver or phoneme-level lip-sync.

voiceProfile.name: Miss minutes
voiceProfile.playback: Android selects Talk_Loop during ElevenLabs playback and returns to the AI-selected motion afterward.
voiceProfile.apiKeyStorage: Android Keystore; credentials are not committed.

blockers: Replace the current transform-only Android GLB with the supplied advanced rig after repairing its missing controls and integrating it into the repository asset pipeline.
Add weighted, independently articulated ring fingers and verify all hand joints.
Add independent eyebrow controls and separate hour/minute clock hands to the advanced source model.
Add facial morph targets or a verified equivalent for blink, smile, jaw opening and phoneme shapes.
Implement runtime joint/morph driving and phoneme-timed speech synchronization.
Run Android visual and performance tests on the target device.
